sections.name: Intro
sections.text: {a woodblock clock starts ticking on the first beat, the marimba picks up its even broken-chord eighths beside it, and the first music-box note leans in}

sections.name: Main Theme
sections.text: {the curious melody in A Dorian on music box: little climbing phrases that end on an upward question, over the ticking clock and marimba, the bright D major chord lifting it}

sections.name: Main Theme Reprise
sections.text: {the same melody again, now a bassoon-like reed counter-line answers each phrase from below, soft strings under it, like two minds working the same problem}

sections.name: Bridge
sections.text: {contrast: the tune moves to C major and G major, slower longer notes, a moment of quiet discovery as a lens comes into focus, the clock still ticking under it}

sections.name: Main Theme Return
sections.text: {the curious A Dorian melody returns on music box with the reed answering; the last bar steps straight back into the main theme}
